integrity: Analytic proof provided with explicit quantifiers and supplementary stand-alone finite numerical checks. Precedence is qualified and requires independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Hurst parameter in (0,1), fixed positive power exponent, independent one-uniform-per-panel randomization, sign occupation of standard fractional Brownian motion started at zero; not a universal optimal-grid or adaptive estimator result.
title: Sharp phase diagram and optimal power grading for randomized fractional Brownian occupation quadrature
